name: AI Optimizer for Google Featured Snippet & Generative AI
author: AnswerSEO

sections.description:
AI Optimizer for Google Featured Snippets (Position Zero) helps you to prepare your website for Featured snippet.

This lightweight plugin analyzes your post and page content to improve structure, readability, and relevance for AI-driven search engines like ChatGPT, Google SGE, and Gemini. It automatically injects FAQPage JSON-LD schema markup, giving your site a higher chance to appear in Google Featured Snippets, Rich Results, and Position Zero.

Search engines and AI platforms favor structured, clear, and informative content — this plugin ensures your site meets those standards.

Key Features

  • ✅ FAQ Management in Post/Page Editor – Easily add multiple FAQ fields directly in your WordPress editor.
  • ✅ Automatic FAQ Schema Injection – Automatically adds FAQPage JSON-LD structured data for improved SEO.
  • ✅ AI & SEO Content Analyzer – Scans your content’s titles, headings, and paragraphs for AI-friendliness.
  • ✅ Unlimited FAQs per Post/Page – Add as many FAQs as you like to make content more valuable and structured.

Why Use This Plugin?

AI-driven search results are the future of SEO. This plugin helps your content align with the latest ranking signals from both Google and AI-based answer engines by combining:
– Smart AI content analysis
– SEO best practices
– Structured data markup (FAQPage JSON-LD)

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Edit any post or page to add FAQs
